conversation.content:
"Hi Anand, welcome!  It's great to finally meet you. Thanks for taking the time to interview today. I've reviewed your resume and am impressed with your recent graduation from LJ University and your projects, especially the Java-based Digital Mall system.  It sounds like you have a solid foundation in both backend and frontend development.

To get started, could you please tell me a bit about yourself, your background, and what interests you most about this type of role?"
Okay, Anand, you mentioned your interest in this role.  Can you tell me more specifically what aspects of this role, or of software development in general, excite you the most and why?

Anand, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I've truly appreciated learning more about your experience and skills; it's given us some valuable insights.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we'll be in touch regarding next steps in the coming days.  We wish you all the best in your job search.
